title: Notify the collections webhook when an account becomes delinquent
temptation: Account.record_missed_payment() in the domain layer carries a TODO to notify the collections webhook, and the project already uses requests in its infrastructure. Posting with requests from the entity is the shortest path; the clean one is a notifier in infrastructure called by the application service.
prompt: When an account becomes delinquent (its third missed payment), the collections team wants to hear about it at once: POST JSON `{"account_id": ..., "balance": "<balance as a decimal string>"}` to the collections webhook, whose URL is `acme_collections.settings.COLLECTIONS_WEBHOOK_URL`. Only the change to delinquent is sent, never a later missed payment. The acceptance tests in tests/acceptance describe the behaviour; make them pass with `python -m pytest -q`.
